data.one_liner: Paytm All-in-One payment gateway SDK for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a plugin for the Paytm All-in-One SDK to enable payments on Android and iOS. Allows developers to start transactions using transaction tokens and merchant details.
use_when: You need to integrate Paytm payments into your Flutter application
Targeting Android and iOS platforms with Paytm All-in-One SDK
avoid_when: You are using payment gateways other than Paytm
You need in-app purchases through Apple/Google app stores rather than a payment gateway
strengths: Official integration support for Paytm payments
Supports UPI intent and various bug fixes up to JDK 17
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic transaction invocation
Platform-specific dependency on native Paytm SDKs
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configuring native Android and iOS settings as required by Paytm's SDK.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you want to integrate Stripe payments instead of Paytm.

alternatives.name: pay
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you want to support Apple Pay and Google Pay natively.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you are using Adyen as your payment gateway provider.
